categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Everdisplay Optronics Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of high-resolution AMOLED semiconductor display panels. Its products serve various applications including smartphones, smart wearables, tablets, notebooks, automotive displays, and aviation displays. The company is a leading domestic player in mid-sized AMOLED panels, especially for IT and automotive sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AMOLED technologies such as Hybrid display form factor, Tandem stacked OLED technology, LTPO (Low Temperature Polycrystalline Oxide), TOE (Thin Film Encapsulation integrated touch), and high-frequency PWM dimming. It has proprietary panel design, organic film deposition, flexible encapsulation, and drive circuit technologies. Production involves 4.5 and 6th generation AMOLED lines with capabilities for both rigid and flexible panels, emphasizing precision manufacturing and yield improvement.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international brands in consumer electronics, particularly in smartphones, smart wearables, tablets, notebooks, automotive infotainment, and aviation display sectors. The company has a strong presence with top-tier clients, including newly added major customers like Honor Terminal Co., Ltd., and serves both domestic and overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with its headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Shanghai's Jinshan Industrial Zone. It also has significant overseas sales, with about 27.29% of revenue from international markets including the US, Japan, South Korea, and Europe. It actively expands its overseas customer base and product applications globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Everdisplay Optronics operates mainly in the midstream of the AMOLED semiconductor display panel supply chain, focusing on panel design, manufacturing, and sales. It procures raw materials and equipment from upstream suppliers and sells finished display panels downstream to device manufacturers and brand customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in AMOLED display technologies, focusing on breakthroughs in Hybrid, Tandem, LTPO, and flexible touch integration. It invests heavily in R&D (about 10% of revenue), aiming to accelerate technology commercialization and expand advanced production capacity. Strategic goals include leading mid-sized AMOLED markets, expanding new application scenarios, and enhancing digital and lean manufacturing capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of self-developed and manufactured AMOLED semiconductor display panels. Sales are conducted via direct sales and trade channels, both on a buyout basis. The company also earns income from related services, government subsidies, and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in mid-sized AMOLED panels, holding the top market share in China for tablet and notebook AMOLED displays and ranking among the top globally. It competes with major international AMOLED manufacturers, particularly those based in South Korea and China, by leveraging differentiated technology and flexible production strategies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 4.96 billion, a 63.19% increase year-over-year, driven by volume and price improvements. Despite continued net losses (about RMB -2.52 billion), losses narrowed compared to prior years. The company shows a growth trajectory with expanding production capacity and improving gross margins, supported by increased R&D investment and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-resolution, high-performance AMOLED panels with superior attributes such as thinness, brightness, durability, and long lifespan. Its proprietary technologies like Hybrid and Tandem enable lightweight, flexible, and energy-efficient displays tailored for high-end applications. The firm offers comprehensive product portfolios across multiple device categories, backed by strong R&D, quality management, and customer collaboration, delivering differentiated value to premium brand customers.
